description: React component for the top navigation bar of a web application, including user authentication controls, language and currency selection, and a modal login/register component.

classes.name: TopNavBar
classes.description: React component class for the top navigation bar with user account and language/currency options.

methods.name: loginClicked
methods.description: Displays the login modal with login mode.

methods.name: registerClicked
methods.description: Displays the login modal with registration mode.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user and reloads the page.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the navigation bar UI, including user account info, language and currency options, and login/register modal.
